evidence:

body:
## Summary
Both suites set DESK_DATA_DIR to a new artifacts/<suite>/<ms>/ folder inside the tree on every run and never removed it (hand-off from desk-tooling).

## Description
tools/linga-rules-test.cjs:6 and tools/linga-moment-test.cjs:6 (before the fix) built the data dir under the repo; the main checkout held 283 + 9 such folders. The brief and SKILL §7.7 put scratch in the OS temp dir. Fixed with the linga-level-rules-test idiom: fs.mkdtempSync(os.tmpdir()) and fs.rmSync in after().

## Flow
- run node tools/linga-rules-test.cjs
- one more artifacts/linga-rules/<ms>/ folder stays behind
- fix: mkdtemp under os.tmpdir(), removed in after()

## Expected impact
The tree and `git status --ignored` stop collecting a folder per gate run. Could break: nothing reads those folders (zero consumers of artifacts/linga-rules, artifacts/linga-moment).

## Evaluation
Claim: other - no scratch left in the tree per run
Before: +1 folder under artifacts/linga-rules and +1 under artifacts/linga-moment per run
After: +0 and +0; 0 desk-linga-* dirs left in the OS temp dir
Method: gate - both suites run on HEAD and on the change, folder counts taken before and after each run
Result: better
Gate: none

Fixed: a lost ladder answers once with the line the A1-A2 path already uses and drops the session's help, so the button stops being offered. The shared idiom and a loss counter across the four maps stay with the linga-scenes Lane B card.

- the desk restarts mid-scene; the session still names rungs [1,2,3]

- before: Help me answer -> nothing changes, the button stays
- after: "You can type your own reply on the phone." once, then no help button

## Expected impact
A learner after a restart is told what to do instead of pressing a dead button. Could break: nothing that reads help when it is null already (the null ladder path existed).

## Evaluation
Claim: user - every help press puts something on screen
Before: on-screen line after the press "", help still offered (unbounded silent presses)
After: the type-your-own line; help no longer offered
Method: gate - tools/linga-rules-test.cjs new case, red on HEAD ("the press puts a line on screen"), green after

title: Any paired phone could spend the voice and transcription engines
evidence:
desk/src/app/api/speak/route.ts (HEAD~): no role check; speak({ text: text.slice(0, 900) })
desk/src/app/api/listen/route.ts (HEAD~): no role check; up to 25 MB to listen()
callers: desk/src/app/tv/page.tsx:102, desk/src/english/useEnglishAudio.ts:28 (TV), desk/src/english/LingaTestBar.tsx:51 (TV page)
precedent: desk/src/app/api/analyse/route.ts:99 shelf-piece TV-only 403
registry: voice-io / portable-provider-package 'The host wrapper: a route is policy' (authentication as defense in depth)
body:
## Summary
Only the TV calls the speech routes, but neither checked the caller's role, so a paired phone could make the desk synthesise arbitrary text (a paid ElevenLabs call) or transcribe arbitrary audio.

## Description
desk/src/app/api/speak/route.ts and desk/src/app/api/listen/route.ts served any role the proxy let through (TV and phone). The registry's voice-io technique portable-provider-package says the host route owns authentication even behind an outer proxy. Fixed: a phone (any role but tv) is refused 403 before the engine runs; a call with no role (in-process, tests) is served as before, as the analyse route's shelf-piece door does. Throttling per caller (the same technique) is not added: after this only the TV reaches the route.

## Flow
- a paired phone POSTs /api/speak {text}
- before: the voice engine runs and returns audio
- after: 403 "Only the TV speaks the lines." with 0 engine runs

## Expected impact
A phone on the LAN cannot run up the voice bill or the transcriber. Could break: a phone surface that called these routes (none: grep finds only TV callers).

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - only the TV spends the speech engines
Before: phone speak and listen calls served 2 of 2, engine run each
After: refused 403 2 of 2, 0 engine runs; TV and no-role calls served 4 of 4
Method: gate - tools/linga-rules-test.cjs new case with stub providers; seeded with HEAD's routes -> "a phone is refused, 200 !== 403"
Result: better
Gate: policy-tighten

body:
## Summary
useEnglish, the one client door to /api/english, parsed the body before checking r.ok, so a crash page became the TV caption as a SyntaxError message.

## Description
desk/src/english/useEnglish.ts read `await r.json()` unguarded; its catch put e.message into error, which lingaView shows as the caption (view.ts error) and the phone as an alert. 38 other sites in desk/src read refused bodies with r.json().catch. Fixed: replyError(r) - done on a 2xx, else the route's own error, else "That did not reach the tutor.".

## Flow
- the desk route crashes and Next answers an HTML 500
- before: the TV caption reads "Unexpected token '<', "<!DOCTYPE "... is not valid JSON"
- after: "That did not reach the tutor."

## Expected impact
A learner never sees a parser message on the TV. Could break: a 2xx with a non-JSON body now counts as done (it threw before; the route always answers JSON).

## Evaluation
Claim: user - a failed command leaves a desk sentence
Before: HTML 500 and empty 502 -> SyntaxError text
After: desk sentence; a JSON 409 keeps its own error on both sides
Method: gate - tools/linga-rules-test.cjs replyError case, seeded red with HEAD's body, green after

English. Speak it or type it...

... listen(setSentence) (no tab) desk/src/app/phone/recogniserLang.ts:11-12 tab === "essay" ? "en-US" : learnerLang(s) eb97cef2 fix(essay): Essay dictation listens in English whatever the school system (the pair fixed on one side) tools/phone-panel-test.cjs:588 pins ['','maths','english'] -> cs-CZ desk/src/english/ReplyBox.tsx:58 Linga's reply box hard-codes en-US (so recogniserLang.ts:10 'Math and Linga follow the learner' is false for Linga)
body:
## Summary
The phone's "Say a sentence" screen asks for an English sentence but its Mic listens in cs-CZ for a Czech learner; eb97cef2 fixed the same defect for Essay only.

## Description
recogniserLangFor answers en-US only for tab "essay" (desk/src/app/phone/recogniserLang.ts:11-12). The Say screen calls listen(setSentence) with no tab (desk/src/app/phone/page.tsx:863), so a Czech learner's English sentence goes to a Czech recogniser. The header comment (recogniserLang.ts:10) also says Linga follows the learner, while Linga's reply box listens en-US (desk/src/english/ReplyBox.tsx:58). Fixed would be: a "say" tab answered en-US, the Say Mic passing it, the comment corrected. page.tsx and phone-panel-test.cjs belong to phone-surface, so out of this round's paths.

## Flow
- a Czech learner opens Say a sentence on the phone
- presses Mic and says "I have gone to school yesterday"
- the cs-CZ recogniser returns Czech-shaped text; the tense card reads garbage
- fix: listen(setSentence, "say"); recogniserLangFor("say") -> en-US

## Expected impact
Dictated English sentences are transcribed as English. Could break: a Czech learner who wanted to dictate Czech there (the screen says English).

## Evaluation
Claim: user - English dictation is heard in English
Before: Say a sentence Mic language for a cz learner: cs-CZ (walked from recogniserLang.ts:11 and page.tsx:863)
After: en-US (predicted)
Method: simulation - out of this round's paths (page.tsx, phone-panel-test.cjs are phone-surface's); three walks: cz learner -> cs-CZ, en learner -> en-US, nobody seated -> en-US
Result: better
Gate: none

title: The Sentence help caption reaches the TV with prompt-only withholding
instrument: a code check captionLeaks(explanation, card, sentence) in desk/src/lib/rules/english.ts (any '→', the card's findIt example forms, the learner verb's irregular past/participle from the warning list, or verb+ed when the card asks for the past), applied in desk/src/lib/desk/english.ts with one re-ask then a code-written fallback; fixtures from voice-rules-test's stubbed english.sentence and three seeded leaking captions (red), then green
evidence:
desk/src/lib/desk/english.ts:11-12 ENGLISH_WITHHOLD (prompt text only)
desk/src/lib/desk/english.ts:39 return { sentence, card, explanation: json.explanation, provider }  (no check)
desk/src/lib/desk/spoken.ts:13 the explanation is spoken; desk/src/tv/screens.tsx:263 drawn
desk/src/lib/rules/english.ts:27-28 findIt carries example pairs (go → went, go → gone)
AGENTS.md: 'Withholding is the product: nothing puts the answer on screen'
body:
## Summary
analyseSentence puts the model's caption on the TV and speaks it with no code check that it withholds the corrected form; the withholding is only a prompt sentence.

## Description
desk/src/lib/desk/english.ts returns json.explanation as is (line 39); spoken.ts:13 speaks it and screens.tsx:263 draws it. Every other teaching surface that could leak an answer has a code check (the hint's leaksLine, Explain's leak check, the Linga moment's withholding in repair.ts); this caption has ENGLISH_WITHHOLD in the prompt only. The rule card the model sees carries example forms (rules/english.ts:27-28) the prompt tells it not to repeat. Fixed would be a code check with a re-ask and a code-written fallback. M, risk 4: rules/english.ts is on the live surface (drift record owed) and the fallback copy is a product call.

## Flow
- Say a sentence: "She go to school yesterday."
- the card asks for the past simple; the model writes "...you need went here"
- the TV shows and speaks the corrected form
- fix: captionLeaks flags it; one re-ask; else a code caption naming the time word only

## Expected impact
The English caption keeps the product's withholding rule in code, as the other surfaces do. Could break: a correct caption mis-flagged by a too-broad check (fixtures decide).

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - no corrected form on the TV caption
Before: code checks on the caption: 0 (grep of .explanation consumers: spoken.ts, screens.tsx only)
After: not measured: the leak rate of the live caption needs the instrument and a live sample
Method: simulation - walked three sentences against the card text; the rate needs live captions (operator) and the check needs fixtures
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
